faq.heading: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.q1: Can I track the location of my booked bus online?
faq.a1: Yes, you can track your bus online by using our bus tracking app feature called Track My Bus. This feature allows passengers and their families to track the live bus location on a map and plan pick-ups safely.
faq.q2: Why book bus tickets online on tedbus?
faq.a2: Booking on tedbus gives you instant seat selection, verified bus operators, live bus tracking, exclusive discounts, and secure online payments from anywhere.
faq.q3: Do I need to create an account on the tedbus site to book my bus ticket?
faq.a3: You can search buses and check seat availability without an account. Signing in with your account helps save your bookings, preferences, and trip history.
faq.q4: Does bus booking online cost me more?
faq.a4: Not at all! Online booking on tedbus offers transparent fares with no hidden charges, plus regular promo codes and discounts.
faq.q5: How can I get discounts on bus booking?
faq.a5: Check the Trending Offers section on the home page and apply coupon codes such as FIRST, SUPERHIT, BUS300, or RBTRIP during payment.
faq.q6: What's new in bus booking on tedbus?
faq.a6: tedbus now supports instant Dark Mode, multi-language support (English, Hindi, and Marathi), live tracking filters, and seamless online seat selection.
faq.q7: Can I book a Government bus ticket on tedbus?
faq.a7: Yes, tedbus partners with major state RTC operators across India including APSRTC, GSRTC, MSRTC, TNSTC, TSRTC, RSRTC, and Kerala RTC.
